statement: WITH cohort AS (SELECT channel_id, validation_stratum FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_lid_v3_validation_10k_20260608_161345_b10_cohort_sample), channels AS (SELECT channel_id, models_agree_exact_primary, models_agree_iso_primary, requires_manual_adjudication FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_lid_v3_validation_10k_20260608_161345_b10_channels WHERE run_id = 'codex_10k_20260608_161345_b10'), pred_long AS (SELECT 'openlid' AS model, channel_id, segment_id, label_1 AS label, iso639_3_1 AS iso, script_1 AS script, score_1 AS score, 1 AS prediction_rank FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_lid_v3_validation_10k_20260608_161345_b10_openlid_predictions_compact WHERE run_id = 'codex_10k_20260608_161345_b10' AND segment_type = 'video_title' AND label_1 IS NOT NULL AND score_1 >= 0.20 UNION ALL SELECT 'openlid' AS model, channel_id, segment_id, label_2 AS label, iso639_3_2 AS iso, script_2 AS script, score_2 AS score, 2 AS prediction_rank FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_lid_v3_validation_10k_20260608_161345_b10_openlid_predictions_compact WHERE run_id = 'codex_10k_20260608_161345_b10' AND segment_type = 'video_title' AND label_2 IS NOT NULL AND score_2 >= 0.35 AND score_1 > 0 AND score_2 / score_1 >= 0.50 UNION ALL SELECT 'glotlid' AS model, channel_id, segment_id, label_1 AS label, iso639_3_1 AS iso, script_1 AS script, score_1 AS score, 1 AS prediction_rank FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_lid_v3_validation_10k_20260608_161345_b10_glotlid_predictions_compact WHERE run_id = 'codex_10k_20260608_161345_b10' AND segment_type = 'video_title' AND label_1 IS NOT NULL AND score_1 >= 0.20 UNION ALL SELECT 'glotlid' AS model, channel_id, segment_id, label_2 AS label, iso639_3_2 AS iso, script_2 AS script, score_2 AS score, 2 AS prediction_rank FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_lid_v3_validation_10k_20260608_161345_b10_glotlid_predictions_compact WHERE run_id = 'codex_10k_20260608_161345_b10' AND segment_type = 'video_title' AND label_2 IS NOT NULL AND score_2 >= 0.35 AND score_1 > 0 AND score_2 / score_1 >= 0.50), votes AS (SELECT model, channel_id, label, iso, script, SUM(score * CASE WHEN prediction_rank = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.20 END) AS weighted_score, SUM(CASE WHEN prediction_rank = 1 THEN score ELSE 0.0 END) AS top1_weighted_score, COUNT(DISTINCT segment_id) AS segment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN prediction_rank = 1 THEN segment_id END) AS top1_segment_count, MAX(score) AS max_segment_score FROM pred_long GROUP BY model, channel_id, label, iso, script), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model, channel_id ORDER BY weighted_score DESC, segment_count DESC, max_segment_score DESC, label ASC) AS language_rank FROM votes), title_primary AS (SELECT channel_id, MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'openlid' AND language_rank = 1 THEN label END) AS title_openlid_label, MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'openlid' AND language_rank = 1 THEN iso END) AS title_openlid_iso, MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'glotlid' AND language_rank = 1 THEN label END) AS title_glotlid_label, MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'glotlid' AND language_rank = 1 THEN iso END) AS title_glotlid_iso FROM ranked WHERE language_rank = 1 GROUP BY channel_id), joined AS (SELECT c.validation_stratum, c.channel_id, ch.models_agree_exact_primary, ch.models_agree_iso_primary, ch.requires_manual_adjudication, tp.title_openlid_label, tp.title_openlid_iso, tp.title_glotlid_label, tp.title_glotlid_iso, (tp.title_openlid_label IS NOT NULL AND tp.title_glotlid_label IS NOT NULL) AS title_both_classified, (tp.title_openlid_label = tp.title_glotlid_label AND tp.title_openlid_label IS NOT NULL AND tp.title_glotlid_label IS NOT NULL) AS title_exact_agree, (tp.title_openlid_iso = tp.title_glotlid_iso AND tp.title_openlid_iso IS NOT NULL AND tp.title_glotlid_iso IS NOT NULL) AS title_iso_agree FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN channels ch ON c.channel_id = ch.channel_id LEFT JOIN title_primary tp ON c.channel_id = tp.channel_id), agg AS (SELECT 'overall' AS validation_stratum, COUNT(*) AS n_channels, SUM(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS title_both_classified, AVG(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS title_coverage_rate_all_channels, SUM(CASE WHEN title_exact_agree THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS title_exact_agreements, AVG(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN CASE WHEN title_exact_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS title_exact_rate_among_both_classified, AVG(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN CASE WHEN title_iso_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS title_iso_rate_among_both_classified, AVG(CASE WHEN title_exact_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS title_exact_rate_all_channels, AVG(CASE WHEN title_iso_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS title_iso_rate_all_channels, AVG(CAST(models_agree_exact_primary AS DOUBLE)) AS all_segment_exact_rate, AVG(CAST(models_agree_iso_primary AS DOUBLE)) AS all_segment_iso_rate, AVG(CAST(requires_manual_adjudication AS DOUBLE)) AS all_segment_manual_rate FROM joined UNION ALL SELECT validation_stratum, COUNT(*) AS n_channels, SUM(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS title_both_classified, AVG(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS title_coverage_rate_all_channels, SUM(CASE WHEN title_exact_agree THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS title_exact_agreements, AVG(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN CASE WHEN title_exact_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS title_exact_rate_among_both_classified, AVG(CASE WHEN title_both_classified THEN CASE WHEN title_iso_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS title_iso_rate_among_both_classified, AVG(CASE WHEN title_exact_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS title_exact_rate_all_channels, AVG(CASE WHEN title_iso_agree THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS title_iso_rate_all_channels, AVG(CAST(models_agree_exact_primary AS DOUBLE)) AS all_segment_exact_rate, AVG(CAST(models_agree_iso_primary AS DOUBLE)) AS all_segment_iso_rate, AVG(CAST(requires_manual_adjudication AS DOUBLE)) AS all_segment_manual_rate FROM joined GROUP BY validation_stratum) SELECT * FROM agg ORDER BY CASE validation_stratum WHEN 'overall' THEN 0 WHEN 'previous_exact_agreement' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
